name: skopli
description: Read real AI coding-agent usage (tokens, sessions, calls) from local harness state, aggregate it, and price it against market catalogs like OpenRouter and LiteLLM.

scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release -o native --js index.cjs --package skopli-node --manifest-path crates/skopli-node/Cargo.toml
scripts.build: napi build --platform --release -o native --js index.cjs --package skopli-node --manifest-path crates/skopli-node/Cargo.toml && pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
